status_vocabulary.source_present: Boolean: implementation code exists in cited source tree.
status_vocabulary.compiled: Boolean: true only after successful compilation of the cited revision.
status_vocabulary.integrated: Boolean: source is connected to a kernel build target; this does not mean merged to main.
status_vocabulary.runtime_verified: Boolean: true only after runtime behavior is exercised on the exact artifact.
status_vocabulary.hardware_verified: Boolean: true only after verification on identified physical hardware.
status_vocabulary.status_fields: Adjacent *_status and evidence fields explain pending work and source evidence.

components.scope: Hardware-rooted boot chain, verified images, rollback prevention and owner key lifecycle
Protected VM, isolated services, IOMMU and critical secret separation
Hardware-backed credentials, key lifecycle and attestation
Universal process/application capabilities, syscall, filesystem and hardware sandbox
Kernel per-application network policy, DNS/VPN isolation and traffic controls
Authenticated recovery, panic evidence, atomic rollback and interrupted-update recovery
ELE-specific adaptive scheduling, heterogeneous placement, fairness and thermal/energy policy
Adaptive reclaim, compression, cgroup policy, NUMA and GPU/NPU coordination
Frequency, battery, thermal, suspend/resume and wake policy
Modular device drivers, USB, cameras, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, NFC, satellite and peripherals
Binder, GKI/KMI, SELinux, HALs, runtime, graphics/camera and Bluetooth compatibility on ACK 6.18
components.notes: Build scaffold only: kernel/build.py pins the intended branch name, rejects non-6.18 versions, runs Kleaf targets, validates a config and image header, and writes provenance. It does not validate manifest identity, compile/boot evidence, KMI, Binder, SELinux, HALs, graphics, camera, Bluetooth, or APK compatibility.

release_gate: Do not mark complete until all required components have source, successful target builds, appropriate runtime/security tests, and hardware results where hardware is required.
